title: Fix deployment errors — TypeScript, routing, backend compilation, and runtime issues

requirements.text: Audit and fix all TypeScript compilation errors across the entire frontend codebase — including `frontend/src/App.tsx`, all page components, all hooks, and all utility files — so that the frontend bundle builds successfully without type errors, missing imports, undefined variables, or broken module references.
acceptanceCriteria: Running the frontend build command produces zero TypeScript compilation errors
No missing import or undefined variable errors appear in any source file
The frontend bundle is produced successfully

requirements.text: Audit and fix `frontend/src/App.tsx` to remove any route definitions that simultaneously set both an `id` and a `path` option on the same route object. Remove or rename the conflicting `id` property so the router initializes without throwing 'Route cannot have both an id and a path option'. Verify all existing route paths and navigation links remain functional after the fix.
acceptanceCriteria: No route object in App.tsx has both an `id` and a `path` property simultaneously
The router initializes without throwing 'Route cannot have both an id and a path option'
All existing page routes remain navigable

requirements.text: Audit and fix all compilation and runtime errors in `backend/main.mo` and `backend/migration.mo` that prevent the canister from deploying successfully. Ensure all Motoko syntax is valid, all imported modules resolve correctly, all stable variable declarations are compatible with the current Motoko compiler version, and the actor compiles and deploys without errors.
acceptanceCriteria: The backend canister compiles without any Motoko errors or warnings that block deployment
The canister deploys and initializes successfully
`system func init()` and `system func postupgrade()` execute without runtime errors

requirements.text: Fix the image source rendering utility in `frontend/src/utils/imageHelpers.ts` and audit every component and page that renders product or template images (`FeaturedProducts.tsx`, `ProductDetailPage.tsx`, `ShopFramesBySize.tsx`, `ProductCategoryGrid.tsx`, `AdminDashboardPage.tsx`, `ProductManagementPage.tsx`, `TemplateManagementPage.tsx`, `CartPage.tsx`, `OrderDetailPage.tsx`). Wherever an image `src` is constructed by prepending a `data:image/...;base64,` prefix to a plain HTTP/HTTPS URL, remove the erroneous prefix so the `src` attribute receives the raw URL. Images stored as genuine base64 data URIs must continue to render correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Product and template images stored as plain HTTP URLs render correctly without a malformed `data:image/jpeg;base64,https://...` prefix
Images stored as genuine base64 data URIs continue to display correctly
No broken image icons appear in product cards, product detail, cart, or admin pages

requirements.text: Fix the admin session credential validation in `frontend/src/hooks/useAdminSession.ts` so that the `login` function correctly accepts both hardcoded admin accounts — (1) username `genmitra`, password `12345678` and (2) username `admin`, password `Admin@1234` — and sets session state with role `admin` on a successful match. Eliminate any typos, strict equality issues, or stale cached state that cause valid credentials to be rejected.
acceptanceCriteria: Logging in with username `genmitra` and password `12345678` sets the admin session successfully
Logging in with username `admin` and password `Admin@1234` sets the admin session successfully
Invalid credentials are still rejected
No stale session state causes a valid login to silently fail

requirements.text: Audit and fix `frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx` to ensure: (a) in admin login mode (triggered when arriving from an `/admin` route), only the credential-based username/password form is rendered and Internet Identity is never triggered or displayed; (b) the form correctly calls `login` from `useAdminSession` with no early returns or silent swallows; (c) on successful validation the user is redirected to `/admin` or the originally requested admin URL; (d) in regular user login mode, `login` from `useInternetIdentity` is called correctly and the user is redirected to the main website after successful authentication.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to `/admin` while unauthenticated shows only the username/password form with no Internet Identity elements
Submitting valid admin credentials redirects to `/admin`
Internet Identity login works correctly for non-admin users and redirects to the homepage
No silent form submission failures occur

requirements.text: Audit and fix `frontend/src/components/admin/AdminGuard.tsx` to ensure it never calls `login()` from `useInternetIdentity` or any Internet Identity hook. The guard must only check the local credential-based admin session via `useAdminSession` and redirect unauthenticated visitors to the login page. If the session is valid, allow the protected route to render.
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting `/admin` while unauthenticated redirects to the login page without triggering Internet Identity
A valid admin session allows the admin route to render
AdminGuard imports no Internet Identity hooks and calls no `login()` function from them

requirements.text: Fix the backend role-check guard in `backend/main.mo` for all write-protected functions (`createProduct`, `updateProduct`, `deleteProduct`, `createTemplate`, `updateTemplate`, `deleteTemplate`) so that the caller's role is resolved by looking up the caller's principal in the stable users map. Remove any broken JWT string parsing, stale in-memory lookups, or principal mismatches that cause valid admin sessions to be rejected with 'Unauthorized' errors. Ensure `system func init()` and `system func postupgrade()` upsert both admin seed accounts — (1) username `genmitra`, password `12345678`, role `admin` and (2) username `admin`, password `Admin@1234`, role `admin` — and the regular user seed (username `genmitra`, password `1234`, role `user`) into stable storage on every canister initialization and upgrade.
acceptanceCriteria: A logged-in admin can create, update, and delete products and templates without receiving 'Unauthorized' errors
Both admin seed accounts are present in stable storage after every deploy
The regular user seed is also present after every deploy
Non-admin principals are still correctly rejected by write-protected functions

requirements.text: Verify and fix all mutation hooks in `frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts` — specifically `createTemplate`, `updateTemplate`, `deleteTemplate`, `createProduct`, `updateProduct`, and `deleteProduct` — to ensure they use the authenticated actor instance derived from the logged-in admin identity context, not an anonymous actor. If any hook captures an anonymous actor at definition time, update it to derive the actor from the current authenticated identity on each call.
acceptanceCriteria: All six mutation hooks use the authenticated actor when called from admin pages
No mutation sends an anonymous caller principal to the backend
Admin product and template CRUD operations succeed without authorization errors

requirements.text: Fix the `useGetProduct` query hook in `frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts` and `frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailPage.tsx` to correctly extract the product ID from route parameters and pass it to the backend `getProduct` call with the correct type (Nat vs. Text). Verify the backend `getProduct` function in `backend/main.mo` correctly looks up the product by ID from the stable products map. Ensure `system func init()` and `system func postupgrade()` upsert all demo product seeds so they are always present after every deploy.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a product card navigates to the ProductDetailPage and the product data loads without a 'Product not found' error
The product ID extracted from the route matches the key format used in the stable products map
Demo products are present after every deploy

requirements.text: Audit `frontend/index.html` Content-Security-Policy `<meta>` tag and all `window.addEventListener('message', handler)` callbacks across the frontend codebase. Ensure `https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz` is present in every origin whitelist and CSP `frame-src`/`script-src` directive. Remove the `frame-ancestors` directive from the CSP `<meta>` tag (it is ineffective there). All other CSP directives must be preserved exactly as-is.
acceptanceCriteria: The `frame-ancestors` directive is absent from the CSP `<meta>` tag
`https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz` is included in all origin whitelists and relevant CSP directives
No 'disallowed origin' errors appear when the app is loaded inside the Caffeine preview iframe
All other CSP directives remain unchanged

requirements.text: Audit all `DialogContent` usages across the entire frontend codebase — including `ProductManagementPage.tsx`, `TemplateManagementPage.tsx`, `OrderManagementPage.tsx`, `CustomerManagementPage.tsx`, `AdminSettingsPage.tsx`, `AdminDashboardPage.tsx`, `CartPage.tsx`, `CheckoutPage.tsx`, and any other component rendering a Radix UI / shadcn `DialogContent` — and add a `<DialogDescription>` child element to every `DialogContent` that is missing one. Where a visible description is not appropriate, use a visually hidden `<DialogDescription>` with a `sr-only` class.
acceptanceCriteria: No Radix UI accessibility warning about missing `DialogDescription` appears in the browser console
Every `DialogContent` in the codebase has a `<DialogDescription>` child or `aria-describedby={undefined}`
The visual layout of all dialogs is unchanged

constraints: Do not modify any files listed in frontend.immutablePaths: useInternetIdentity.ts, useActor.ts, main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
All Motoko logic must remain in the single backend/main.mo actor file
Preserve all existing functional behavior and routing when fixing errors
nonGoals: Adding new features or redesigning existing UI components
Changing the authentication approach (Internet Identity for users, credential-based for admins)
Migrating to a different backend language or frontend framework
